body.because: The triangular lattice has area 0 due to collinear triples; the perturbation approach breaks collinearity at the cost of reducing the minimum area
body.holds_when: The perturbation is large enough to break collinearity but small enough to keep the minimum area above 0.005
body.relation_hint: The perturbed grid in NEW_001 is a response to the collinearity failure of the triangular lattice in NEW_002
body.weakens_when: The perturbation is too small and near-collinear triples remain below 0.005
